english.title: Cause poisonous / injurious matter to flow in waters
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused to flow into waters or tributaries of waters containing fish, liquid or solid matter to such an extent as to cause the waters to be poisonous or injurious to

(A)_[fish.]_
(B)_[the spawning grounds of fish.]_
(C)_[spawn.]_
(D)_[food of fish.]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause to flow into waters/tributaries of waters containing fish any liquid/solid matter to such an extent
as to cause the water to be poisonous/injurious to fish/the spawning grounds of fish/spawn/food of fish

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 41 for definitions.
(ii) See Section 4(2) and (3) for defences.
(iii) The offence of 'causing' requires proof of some positive act leading to that result (Price v Cromack [1975] 2 All ER 113. See also Alphacell Ltd v Woodward [1972] AC 824, [1972] 2 All ER 475.
(iv) See Section 4(3) re limitations as to prosecuting authority - National Rivers Authority certificate required.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Achosi i ddeunydd gwenwynig/niweidiol lifo i ddyfroedd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi achosi i ddeunydd hylifol neu solet lifo i ddyfroedd neu i isddyfroedd yn cynnwys pysgod gan achosi drwy hynny i'r dyfroedd fod yn wenwynig neu'n niweidiol i

(A)_[bysgod]_
(B)_[fannau claddu wyau pysgod]_
(C)_[sil]_
(D)_[fwyd pysgod]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i Adran 4(1) ac Atodlen 4 Deddf Pysgodfeydd Eog a Dwr Croyw 1975.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum and forty pounds for each day on which the offence continues after a conviction thereof.

INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
